panels.sample_scope: Supplementary Fig. 15 | Boundary-exchange contrasts on comparable measured backgrounds. a–c, Temporary-minus-final differences in gross inward (a), gross outward (b) and net inward (c) exchange across the moving 300 km boundary over 0–24 h and 500–925 hPa, in 10¹² kg. The four rows separate the original 80-pair mean, the unweighted mean of 74 pairs with geographic support, and overlap-weighted estimates in those same 74 pairs for geography/season or additionally for measured event state. This separates sample restriction from background weighting. Points and whiskers show estimates and 95% paired-SID percentile intervals; weighted estimates use 2,000 fixed resampling attempts with model refits. All intervals, including those spanning zero, are retained.
